subject: Greenvault — targeted log persistence & SIG/CAIQ evidence request
messages:
From: Andre Morris <andre.morris@greenvault.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@greenvault.com, Patricia Smith <patricia.smith@greenvault.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Tenant-scoped 90d log retention — what evidence can Redwood provide?

Hi Jordan,

Quick question on behalf of our security team: we run a regulated pod of customers and need to retain API request/edge logs for a 90-day forensic window for a subset of tenants. Your default documentation mentions ephemeral session logs (30d) — can you confirm whether Redwood can support a tenant-scoped 90-day retention?

Separately, our auditors want SIG/CAIQ-mapped evidence showing: (1) how retention is scoped to a tenant (configuration screenshots or export), (2) deletion workflows and proof of deletion, and (3) access/audit logs for administrative actions. Could you point me to the artifacts you can supply (or a path to generate them)?

If easier, we can schedule a quick call — but we need a list of deliverables to feed our procurement and security review.

Thanks,
Andre Morris
Head of InfoSec — Greenvault Health
andre.morris@greenvault.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachment: CAIQ_Template_Completed_by_Greenvault.pdf (they attached their completed CAIQ for our reference)

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Andre Morris <andre.morris@greenvault.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Tenant-scoped 90d log retention — what evidence can Redwood provide?

Andre — thanks for the note and the completed CAIQ. Looping in Neha (security) and Priyom (solutions) to scope what we can deliver and the operational changes required.

High-level: I believe we can offer a tenant-scoped 90d retention as a contract addendum for Dedicated/Private customers, or as an enterprise opt-in for Hosted with additional controls. Need to confirm what artifacts to provide for SIG/CAIQ mapping and what implementation work is required.

Neha / Priyom — can you confirm the minimal evidence set (screenshots/exports/attestations) we can provide within 5 business days, and whether the retention can be scoped without impacting other tenants? I’ll share Greenvault’s CAIQ in the thread.

Next steps: once we agree on artifacts, I’ll propose a mutual action plan and get legal involved for the addendum.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 15:46:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Tenant-scoped 90d log retention — what evidence can Redwood provide?

Jordan / Priyom — quick internal run-through.

Summary of constraints:
- Default: session/ephemeral event logs are retained 30 days in Hosted by default (standard product behavior).
- Tenant-scoped retention: feasible if we enable per-tenant retention policies in the logging pipeline and persist slices to a segregated object store bucket for covered tenants. Available for Dedicated and Private; Hosted can be offered as managed opt-in with policy and pricing addendum.

Minimal evidence set we can produce (within a 5 business-day window):
1) SIG/CAIQ mapping excerpt: control IDs related to logging/retention with our redwood-specific responses (we can produce a CSV/worksheet mapping).
2) Configuration export: sample per-tenant retention config (redacted tenant ids) and a screenshot of the console setting where the TTL is applied.
3) Deletion workflow description + example purge log (audit trail) demonstrating a deletion event and the consequent S3 lifecycle/delete markers.
4) Administrative access logs: time-stamped entries for policy changes and who initiated them (will mask internal IDs as appropriate).
5) Attestation letter: a short PDF signed by our security team noting the retention policy and scope for the covered tenant set.

Attachments: I’ve attached a draft addendum that outlines the retention option and implementation notes (redwood_log_retention_addendum_draft.pdf). Also attaching an index of the SIG artifacts we typically provide (redwood_sig_artifact_index.xlsx).

Risk notes: we must ensure tenant isolation since persisting longer increases forensic exposure surface; pricing and indemnity will need legal input. If Greenvault requires longer retention for only a subset of tenants, we’ll need a scoped MAP and a runbook for exporting/ingesting their historical slice.

I recommend we propose a MAP and the list of artifacts to Andre and offer a 30-minute tech walkthrough.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

From: Andre Morris <andre.morris@greenvault.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Patricia Smith <patricia.smith@greenvault.com>, security@greenvault.com
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Tenant-scoped 90d log retention — what evidence can Redwood provide?

Jordan / Neha / Priyom — thanks for the quick internal review.

A few clarifying items from our side:
- We only need 90-day retention for a named subset of tenant IDs belonging to our regulated customers. Tenant scoping is essential; we cannot accept a blanket longer window for all GV tenants.
- For the SIG mapping: please provide the CAIQ control IDs you are mapping to and a sample of your answers (we will include them in our assessment).
- For the deletion proof: an export or example purge record is sufficient (we do not need full logs).

We attached our completed CAIQ and highlighted the controls of interest. Goal is to assemble the artifacts into our security package by next Wednesday.

Can you confirm whether the per-tenant config export will include timestamps and the admin principal? Also, please share a proposed MAP (who does what, and timelines).

Thanks — Andre

Attachment: CAIQ_Completed_Greenvault.pdf

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Andre Morris <andre.morris@greenvault.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 11:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Tenant-scoped 90d log retention — what evidence can Redwood provide?

Andre — appreciate the clarity. Proposed plan below.

What we can deliver (artifacts and timeline):
- SIG/CAIQ mapping excerpt (CSV): control IDs + redwood responses. ETA: 2 business days.
- Sample config export: redacted per-tenant retention config with timestamps and admin principal. ETA: 3 business days.
- Deletion/purge example: sanitized purge log showing lifecycle markers and deletion confirmation. ETA: 3 business days.
- Short attestation PDF signed by our security lead. ETA: 4 business days.

Operational approach:
- We will offer a tenant-scoped 90d retention as a paid opt-in feature for Hosted (implemented as a segregated bucket + per-tenant TTL) or as part of a Dedicated contract. Implementation impact is low on our runtime but requires config gating and audit updates.

Next steps / MAP:
1) Jordan to send MAP and pricing addendum (attached: MAP_Greenvault_90d_retention_v1.docx).
2) Greenvault to confirm list of tenant IDs and sign addendum.
3) Redwood security to produce artifacts and upload to shared evidence folder.
4) Optional 30-min tech walkthrough to review config/export format (we can do this next week).

We’ve created a shared drive folder and uploaded the artifact index; link below. I’ll also open a HubSpot deal record and attach the MAP for your procurement team.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Gv-Redwood-Greenvault-Evidence
HubSpot deal: HS-29384

Please let us know if you want the MAP redlined before we generate the artifacts — otherwise we’ll start producing the SIG/CAIQ mapping and the sample exports once you confirm the tenant list.

— Jordan
